categories.main_business_segments: Yangzhou Huitong Technology Corp., Ltd. specializes in high-end chemical engineering equipment and integrated technical solutions, focusing on polymer materials and hydrogen peroxide production. Its primary business includes equipment manufacturing, design consulting, and EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction) contracting services for high-performance nylon (PA66), bio-based nylon (PA56), biodegradable materials (PBAT/PBS), polyester (PET), and hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) production lines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary patents and technologies in polymerization reactors, esterification and polycondensation reactors, and fluidized bed hydrogenation processes for hydrogen peroxide production. It employs advanced manufacturing techniques for large-scale reactors with capacities up to 600,000 tons/year for polyester and 500,000 tons/year for hydrogen peroxide. The company also integrates intelligent automation and green low-carbon technologies aligned with national strategies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large state-owned enterprises and listed companies in the chemical, petrochemical, and pharmaceutical industries, including Yangnong Chemical, Pingmei Shenma, Kaisai Bio, China Tianchen, Wanhua Chemical, and Yankuang Group. The company serves downstream producers of high-performance nylon, biodegradable plastics, polyester, and hydrogen peroxide, focusing on domestic and select international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant business in North China, East China, Central China, South China, Northwest China, Northeast China, Southwest China, and limited overseas presence including Indonesia. Its headquarters and main manufacturing facilities are located in Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yangzhou Huitong Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical industry supply chain, providing core equipment manufacturing, engineering design, and EPC services that support downstream chemical product manufacturers. It also extends forward into downstream production of polylactic acid (PLA) biodegradable materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on intelligent manufacturing, service-oriented solutions, and green low-carbon development. R&D efforts target polymerization processes for nylon, biodegradable plastics, polyester, and high-purity hydrogen peroxide production. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to develop new catalysts, continuous production technologies, and automation software to enhance production efficiency and environmental sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through sales of proprietary chemical engineering equipment, fees from design consulting services, and comprehensive EPC contracting projects delivering complete production lines. The company operates on an order-based manufacturing model and recognizes revenue upon delivery, acceptance, or progress milestones depending on contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yangzhou Huitong Technology is recognized as a leading domestic player in high-performance nylon equipment and hydrogen peroxide fluidized bed technology, holding a strong market position with differentiated technology and engineering capabilities. It competes with industry peers such as Yangnong Chemical, Pingmei Shenma, and Wanhua Chemical, leveraging patented technologies and comprehensive service offerings to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 662 million, representing an 11.84% increase over 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 108 million, up 9.3%. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.85 billion and equity of RMB 923 million, showing steady growth and improved cash flow from operations. It maintains a solid financial position with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, extensive engineering experience, and integrated service model from design to commissioning. Its patented equipment and process innovations enable higher production capacities, energy efficiency, and environmental compliance. The focus on intelligent, green, and service-oriented solutions differentiates it in the chemical engineering equipment market, supporting customers’ industrial upgrading and sustainable development goals.
